aiResearchSummary.text: Nebia is researching and developing showerhead systems, as described in 'Showerhead for consistent shower experiences over a range of inlet pressures.' The abstract details a system with a mount, a body containing a fluid circuit, and a pressure regulator that manages water supplied at the inlet, aiming to deliver a consistent shower experience regardless of varying inlet pressures. This highlights Nebia’s focus on innovative shower design and water efficiency.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Product Crowdfunding round raised $584,791, or 7.49% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,804,756 to $17,164,857, a 2.2x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
